device.meaning: Whole disk or loop device to set up, named by a single /dev basename; the device is reobserved before a mutation.

role.meaning: NAS role selected for the candidate.

ok.meaning: Whether prefire completed without a refusal.

lockedIn.meaning: Whether the role-labelled partition has a lock-in table row.

sizeBytes.meaning: Candidate raw disk size in bytes.

mainSizeBytes.meaning: Primary raw disk size in bytes, or null when unknown.

fits.meaning: A backup fits when sizeBytes >= mainSizeBytes * (1 - 0.0333); null for role primary.

blank.meaning: True only when no partitions and no filesystem, partition-table or LUKS signature are present.

contents.meaning: Observed partition and signature details, never file names.

partlabel.meaning: Partition label, or null when absent.

type.meaning: Filesystem, LUKS or partition-table type, never a file name; null when absent.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: none means no refusal; nas-main-size-unknown means no primary size is available, nas-backup-too-small means a backup fails sizeBytes >= mainSizeBytes * (1 - 0.0333), and nas-prefire-unavailable means the observation is unavailable.
